CITY OF MONTEREY PARK CITY COUNCIL
  INTRODUCTION OF GUESTS AND PRESENTATIONS
  TUESDAY
  July 16, 2019
  6:00 P.M.
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  320 WEST NEWMARK AVENUE
  Monterey Park, CA 91754

  CONGRATULATIONS!
  To the Monterey Park Manta Rays for your excellent performance in the
2019 Swim-a-thon event. Your hard work and efforts are truly commendable!

  Christopher Morris – 20 laps – Youngest Swimmer (6 years old)

  PRE-COMP GROUP TOP 2:
  Jennifer Chinn - 22 laps
  Erwin Choi - 22 laps

  DISCOVERY GROUP TOP 2:
  Derek Chen - 48 laps
  Patrick Lew - 44 laps

  IMAGINATION GROUPS TOP 3:
  Michael Kwok 52 laps
  Angelina Pang 52 laps
  Alyssa Hong 52 laps

  EXPLORATION GROUPS TOP 3:
  Caitlin Shiung - 66 laps
  Norman Li - 64 laps
  Audrey Qian - 64 laps

  CHALLENGE GROUPS TOP 3:
  Alton Qian 68 laps
  Eric Luong 66 laps
  Aisha Isabelles 66 laps

  SENIOR GROUPS TOP 4:
  Nate Teeraniti - 72 laps
  Kenny You - 72 laps
  Felix Yang - 76 laps
  A. J. Padilla 78 laps - ( also swam the most laps overall)

  TOP FUNDRAISERS:
  Norman Li $250 and Miztli Rosas $200

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)
   IN RECOGNITION!

For representing the Mark Keppel High School Future Business Leaders of America
(FBLA) by competing in the National Competition in San Antonio, Texas and placing
  second in the Nation in Accounting II. This is an incredible accomplishment!.

  Athene Yu

  (Presented by Council Member Ing)
